mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scheduler_execution_log (scheduler_name, execution_status, message, started_at) VALUES (#{schedulerName}, #{status}, #{executionMessage}, #{startedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE scheduler_execution_log SET execution_status = #{status}, message = #{executionMessage}, ended_at = NOW(), duration_ms = TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, started_at, NOW()) DIV 1000 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scheduler_execution_log WHERE scheduler_name = #{schedulerName} AND execution_status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.update: UPDATE scheduler_execution_log SET execution_status = 'FAILED', message = #{executionMessage}, ended_at = NOW(), duration_ms = TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, started_at, NOW()) DIV 1000 WHERE scheduler_name = #{schedulerName} AND execution_status = 'RUNNING' AND started_at < #{timeoutBefore}
